claims.text: The modifications to post-trained BERT include experimenting with different training epochs and dropout probabilities to optimize performance.
The study found that initializing the model with post-trained BERT and varying training epochs from 3 to 10 improved performance compared to lower epochs.
The experiments involved testing 10 different dropout values in the fully connected layer to enhance the model's performance.
